Specification: This module is a small test specification for LET expressions and local definitions in TLA+. It defines a single variable x, a trivial initial predicate and stuttering next-state action, and focuses primarily on checking the behavior of nested LET bindings, local operator definitions, and a helper operator FcnSubst that reconstructs a function by substituting values over its domain. The invariant-like operator Inv performs three tests using Print and Assert from TLC: aliasing an empty set through LET, defining a function over an empty domain, and applying FcnSubst to a sequence-like function to confirm it increments each element as expected.
IfThenElse: IF g = << >> THEN g ELSE LET el == CHOOSE el \in DOMAIN g : TRUE IN [ i \in DOMAIN g |-> IF i = el THEN e(i) ELSE FSub[[j \in (DOMAIN g) \ {el} |-> f[j]]][i]]
IF i = el THEN e(i) ELSE FSub[[j \in (DOMAIN g) \ {el} |-> f[j]]][i]
IF B = {} THEN Print("Test 1 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 1 Failed")
IF C = << >> THEN Print("Test 2 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 2 Failed")
IF FcnSubst(<<1,2,3>>, e) = <<2,3,4>> THEN Print("Test 3 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 3 Failed")
